create_job_config: create a JobConfig dataclass to configure ML job runs with scheduler, device type, and seed settings
configure_slurm_config: configure a SlurmConfig dataclass to set memory, timeout, CPUs per task, and partition for SLURM jobs
configure_scheduler_config: configure a SchedulerConfig dataclass to set scheduler mode, ranks per node, and Ray cluster options
use_scheduler_type_enum: use the SchedulerType enum to select between LOCAL or SLURM scheduling modes for job execution
use_device_type_enum: use the DeviceType enum to select between CPU or CUDA device types for ML workloads
